headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: KUSHIDA went straight to headlining on debut against Darby Allin, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a solid showing. The NJPW junior heavyweight legend made his AEW debut challenging Allin for the TNT Title, testing the champion in a rare junior-style clash before Allin retained.

Turning the clock back to 2025: Adam Page vs. Christopher Daniels settled things in a Texas Death match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 8.30 ? an excellent showing ? part of that year's Maximum Carnage '25 - Night 2.

Looking back to 2025, when Kazuchika Okada vs. Tomohiro Ishii clashed for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.08. It marked Kazuchika Okada's 10th match with the title on the line. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: It was 2023 when it was the first-ever encounter between Bryan Danielson and Bandido on Dynamite, rated 8.77 ? an incredible outing.
Rewind to 2025, when it was Infantry & Moriarty's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.30.
Flash back to 2023, when the AEW All-Atlantic Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Jay Lethal went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.82.
